elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly "shall defend" the Company and its affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: HDI must indemnify the Company and its affiliates from and against "any third-party claim."

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: The indemnity covers allegations that the defined Site or the Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: The indemnity expressly covers claims arising from "HDI's breach of applicable law."

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: It covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content or user information caused by HDI.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: It expressly covers "HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct."

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The Company must give HDI prompt written notice of any covered claim.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: HDI is given control of the defense and settlement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The Company must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: The Company's indemnity is confined to third-party claims arising from Company-provided Content or the Company's breach of applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: HDI indemnifies the Company against third-party claims alleging that the Site or Services infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion is imposed; the rendered indemnity is broader than this permissive fallback exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No Customer-combination exclusion is imposed; the rendered indemnity is broader than this permissive fallback exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion is imposed; the rendered indemnity is broader than this permissive fallback exclusion.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The clause provides no obligation to procure continued use, modify, or replace an infringing item.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no fee-refund remedy tied to the unavailability of the specified IP remedies.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: No three-times-annual-fees super-cap or other indemnity cap appears in the rendered language.
